steps.title: Know your models
steps.html:
Type each gray word in the Filter models box.

@MODELS@

This list is also on the Canvas tab in VR.

steps.title: Go on location
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Playground in Filter environments. Click Playground, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the scene
steps.html:
Press the top button on your right controller, then click Models. Put the Lantern, Firefly, Radio, Bicycle and Solar Panel around the playground.

✋ Grab a model with the palm trigger. Use both palm triggers to make it bigger or smaller.
🗣 Say it out loud: “The ___ shows ___ energy because it ___.”

steps.title: Take the shot and send it
steps.html:
Stand back so the whole scene fits. Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Move the models, take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

vr.full: Your photo shows the Lantern, Firefly, Radio, Bicycle and Solar Panel on the playground.

studio.title: Energy detector

labels.start: Test this prop with all three meters.
labels.q2: What energy does it give off? Tap every one that fits.
labels.done: You tested every prop. Some give off one kind of energy, and some give off more than one. Nice work, crew!

studio.look: Five real props and three meters. A meter is a tool that measures something. The light meter finds light. The heat meter finds heat. The sound meter finds sound.
studio.do: Drag each meter onto the photo, or tap it. Read the gauges. Then tap every kind of energy the prop gives off and tap Check.

frames.lead: 2. How are a candle and a glow stick different?
frames.starter: A candle gives off ___, but a glow stick ___.

studio.full: You tested all 5 props with the meters and tagged their energy. Your 2 sentences have at least 20 words.

things.name: Candle
things.alt: A lit candle with a bright yellow flame
things.ok: Right! A candle flame gives off light and heat.
things.miss: Look at the gauges again. Which meters read lots?

things.name: Glow sticks
things.alt: Glowing glow sticks stuck in the sand at night
things.ok: Right! Glow sticks give off light but almost no heat.
things.miss: Look at the gauges again. Did the heat meter find anything?

things.name: Drum
things.alt: Old photo of a man playing a drum with two sticks
things.ok: Right! A drum being played gives off sound.
things.miss: Look at the gauges again. Which meter read lots?

things.name: Hot cocoa
things.alt: A cup of hot cocoa on a saucer
things.ok: Right! Hot cocoa gives off heat, but no light.
things.miss: Look at the gauges again. Does a cup glow?

things.name: Firefly
things.alt: A firefly flying with its tail glowing green
things.ok: Right! A firefly makes light with almost no heat.
things.miss: Look at the gauges again. Did the heat meter find much?

voice.brief: Welcome to the playground, crew. We film Scene 28, Lights, Sound, Action. Show me five kinds of energy, then take the shot.
voice.step1: Before your headset goes on, meet your five models. Learn each gray search word. You will type it in VR.
voice.step2: Put on your headset. Click Explore, type Playground, and pick Playground. Then click Begin Solo.
voice.step3: Place the lantern, the firefly, the radio, the bicycle and the solar panel. Then tell me what energy each one shows.
voice.extra: Got time? Add a lamp that lights up a room. That shot is just for VR crews.
voice.step4: Step back so the whole scene fits. Click Library, then Camera, and take the shot. Then send it to Canvas.
voice.step5: Press the Meta button and click Quit. Then open Canvas. Your photo should be waiting there.
voice.studio: No headset today? Come to the studio. Test each prop with three meters. Then tell me what you think.
